scope: Bounded pooled match inference assessment. Descriptive scientific screens; engineering failures block completion.
authority: Owner accepted pooled mover-stayer implementation and bounded assessment.

primary.q1_covariance: Predeclared diagnostic: two concentrated modes, with remainder leading share approximately one.
primary.variance: Separate positive quadratics in within-type normalized leverage midranks; in both offered model spans on the exact design.
primary.design: 12 by 12 mover grid with unequal integer match masses; 36 attached stayers with independent physical histories 2/4/8 and target mass .25/.75. q1 concentrates stayer mass on its first worker; movers remain diffuse.
primary.spectral_interpretation: Outcome-free exact q0 leading shares at most .138. q1 worker/total leading shares exceed .99, firm .50/.86; primary remainder shares at most .130. Covariance deliberately has two concentrated modes and remainder share above .999.
primary.count_note: 1000 outcomes x 8 cells x two arms = 16000 calls, 64000 target rows.

diagnostic_grid.interpretation: All attempts and targets are descriptive; no post-result relabeling of primary cells. Gaussian oracle moments do not describe the heavy-tail cell. Estimated-offset diagnostics compare to an explicitly known-offset FE oracle, not an exact sampling law for estimated controls.

numerics.solver: Explicit diagonal; unchanged default phase tolerances and original-system residual gates
numerics.rng: Independent NumPy PCG64 outcome stream addressed by SHA256(domain, canonical cell, replication), production Counter-V1 numerical addresses; fixed outcome-free numerical seeds per cell/reference across outcome draws. Separate pipeline/development/assessment/diagnostic domains. Mean and fixed-c0 use the same draws and numerical seed.
numerics.fixed_c0: Population mean of the retained working outcome from known DGP; None inference on y-c0.
numerics.actual_mean: Recompute retained physical-frequency working mean on every outcome draw; treat it as fixed only inside inference calculations.

descriptive_screens.status: Descriptive screens registered before outcomes, not public-enablement coverage qualification. Engineering errors block completion; scientific screen failures are enumerated without retuning.
descriptive_screens.q1_conservatism: No upper coverage penalty. q1 highrank SE is descriptive, not a validity gate for AM endpoints.
descriptive_screens.rationale: Predeclared broad descriptive screens. At 1000 draws, binomial MCSE is about .0069 at 95% coverage. Every failed attempt and cell is retained.

engineering_gates.sample: Every designed row retained; exact counts and physical-frequency mean semantics.
engineering_gates.inventory: Exact unique cell/replication/arm/target keys, frozen dimensions, seeds, source, binaries and expected row counts; classify every attempt.
engineering_gates.variance_identification: Before outcome draws, record separate type support, active basis dimensions, joint Gram reciprocal condition and positive DGP variance. Dense diagnostics are assessment-only.

source_binding: Freeze all runtime package files, native payload hashes, harness source hashes, registration hash, exact source commit plus dirty-content identities, DGP/geometry, numerical settings and task inventory before each run. Assessment uses immutable copies. Aggregate only complete validated outputs.
execution: Local private licensed Stata by default. No large run before measured pilot. SCC requires the cluster skill, a tiny local complete path, one real 1--4-core end-to-end smoke, and scheduler dependencies. No public licensed runner.
historical_evidence: All prior observation/match inference and centering experiments retain original identities, failures and scope. No historical receipt is modified.
